tagline: 柯达便携相机，1963 年发布
description: 柯达于1963年推出的便携相机。配备1:11/43 meniscus lens, focusing fixed。快门速度switchable to speeds 1/40 (flash synch.) and 1/90 sec.。使用type 126 film cartridges for 28×28 mm exposures。

specs.胶片/画幅: type 126 film cartridges for 28×28 mm exposures
specs.快门: switchable to speeds 1/40 (flash synch.) and 1/90 sec.
specs.英文简介: Introduced in 1963, the 50 was the first of Kodak's long and successful line of Instamatic “instant load” cameras.
